nodes.name: Checkout
nodes.description: Checkout data shape: computed on update, deserialized from Redis JSON on get and submit

nodes.name: CheckoutSubmitted response
nodes.description: HTTP response returned by POST /checkout/:customerId/submit

nodes.name: orders create response
nodes.description: ExistingOrder body returned by POST /orders and deserialized by the generated client

nodes.name: orders createOrder payload
nodes.description: Order payload built by HttpOrdersService and posted to the orders service

nodes.name: shipping rates
nodes.description: ShippingRates returned by the shipping service for a checkout request

nodes.name: GET /checkout/:customerId
nodes.description: HTTP GET route that returns the checkout stored for a customer id, or 404 when absent

nodes.name: POST /checkout/:customerId/submit
nodes.description: HTTP POST route that submits the stored checkout to orders and removes it from Redis

nodes.name: POST /checkout/:customerId/update
nodes.description: HTTP POST route that accepts a CheckoutRequest body and returns the recalculated Checkout

nodes.name: key
nodes.description: Redis key is the customer id passed to get/set/remove

nodes.name: value
nodes.description: Serialized Checkout JSON string written by serialize(checkout)

nodes.name: Get checkout
nodes.description: Read serialized checkout JSON from Redis by customer id and deserialize it into a Checkout

nodes.name: Submit checkout
nodes.description: Load the checkout, create an order through the orders client, delete the Redis record and return CheckoutSubmitted

nodes.name: Update checkout
nodes.description: Compute item totals, tax and shipping, generate payment identifiers, persist the Checkout in Redis and return it

nodes.name: customerId path parameter
nodes.description: customerId path parameter arriving on the three checkout HTTP routes

nodes.name: CheckoutRequest body
nodes.description: JSON body of POST /checkout/:customerId/update, typed as CheckoutRequest

nodes.name: 404 for missing checkout
nodes.description: GET /checkout/:customerId throws NotFoundException('Checkout not found') when the repository returns no record

nodes.name: Delivery option token match
nodes.description: A rate amount is used only when its token equals request.deliveryOptionToken; an unmatched token leaves shipping -1, normalized to 0 in the total

nodes.name: Global DTO validation
nodes.description: A global Nest ValidationPipe validates the class-validator decorators on CheckoutRequest before the update handler runs

nodes.name: Shipping rates only with an address
nodes.description: Shipping rates are requested only when request.shippingAddress is present; without an address tax and shipping fall back to 0

nodes.name: Checkout required on submit
nodes.description: submit() throws Error('Checkout not found') when no stored checkout exists for the customer id

nodes.name: Redis checkout store
nodes.description: Serialized Checkout JSON kept under the customer id key; reads use the reader client, writes and deletes use the primary client

edges.note: copy email from shippingAddress and items/subtotal/shipping/tax/total from the checkout
Checkout -> Order: shippingAddress.zip -> zipCode, items copied, totals and payment fields dropped
serialize(checkout) -> JSON string written with Redis SET under the customer id key
order.id -> orderId; checkout Redis key is deleted after the order is created
POST /orders with serialized Order; response body deserialized into ExistingOrder
matching rate token/amount copied into checkout.shippingRates and checkout.shipping
customerId becomes the Redis GET key on the reader client
customerId becomes the Redis SET key
customerId becomes the Redis GET key used to load the checkout
items get totalCost=price*quantity; subtotal/tax/shipping/total computed; paymentId/paymentToken generated; address and token copied
deserialize(Checkout, json): serialized JSON string -> Checkout instance; null when key absent
deserialize(Checkout, json): stored JSON string -> Checkout instance via CheckoutService.get
